criteria.activate_my_card: The customer wants to activate a new physical or virtual card.
criteria.age_limit: The customer asks about age requirements for the product.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: The customer asks about Apple Pay or Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: The customer asks which ATMs work with the card or account.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The customer wants to set, change, or stop automatic top-ups.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer was sent but the balance has not updated.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit has not appeared in the balance.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer beneficiary is blocked or not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel a transfer.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring soon and the customer wants a replacement or date.
criteria.card_acceptance: The customer asks where the card can be used or why a merchant declined it.
criteria.card_arrival: The customer asks whether a card has been shipped or when it will arrive.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: The customer wants a delivery time estimate for a card.
criteria.card_linking: The customer wants to link a card to the app or account.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working for payments or ATM use.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: The customer was charged a fee on a card payment.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer does not recognise a card payment.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment used a bad or unexpected FX rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: The customer was charged a fee for a cash withdrawal.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The customer does not recognise a cash withdrawal.
criteria.change_pin: The customer wants to change the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: The card may be compromised, cloned, or used fraudulently.
criteria.country_support: The customer asks whether the product works in a country.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: The customer does not recognise a direct debit.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: The customer asks about disposable virtual card limits.
criteria.edit_personal_details: The customer wants to edit name, address, or other personal details.
criteria.exchange_charge: The customer asks about or disputes a currency exchange fee.
criteria.exchange_rate: The customer asks what exchange rate will be used.
criteria.exchange_via_app: The customer wants to exchange currency in the app.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexpected extra charge appears on the statement.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: The customer asks which fiat currencies are supported.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: The customer wants a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: The customer wants to receive or activate a physical card already ordered.
criteria.getting_spare_card: The customer wants a spare or additional physical card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: The customer wants a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card is lost or stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the banking app is lost or stolen.
criteria.order_physical_card: The customer wants to order a physical card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: The customer forgot the app passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending longer than expected.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked after too many attempts.
criteria.receiving_money: The customer asks how to receive money.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund has not appeared.
criteria.request_refund: The customer wants to request a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, bounced, or reversed.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: The customer asks which cards or currencies are supported.
criteria.terminate_account: The customer wants to close or terminate the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: A fee was charged for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: A fee was charged for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: The customer wants to top up with cash or cheque.
criteria.top_up_limits: The customer asks about top-up limits.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: The customer wants to top up using a card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: A transaction appears to have been charged twice.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: The customer wants to transfer money into the account.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The recipient has not received a transfer.
criteria.transfer_timing: The customer asks how long a transfer takes.
criteria.verify_my_identity: The customer wants to verify their identity.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: The customer is asked to verify the source of funds.
criteria.verify_top_up: The customer needs to verify a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: The customer asks whether the card is Visa or Mastercard.
criteria.why_verify_identity: The customer asks why identity verification is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed the wrong amount of cash.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal used a wrong exchange rate.
